# Real Bruker fixture — AVANCE NEO 400 MHz ¹H (todo 48)

A small **real instrument** acquisition kept in the repository as the independent
raw-data reference for the NMR spectra benchmark and for the todo-42 real
group-delay probe (`tests/test_acp_nmr_spectra_quality.py`).

## Contents

| File | Description | sha256 |
|---|---|---|
| `acqus` | TopSpin 4.0.2 acquisition parameters (sanitized provenance comments; `##$TD` set to the trimmed point count) | `e9e552e5bf8df22812f9f36791fa83294cd19ba9c4399d590d031d57f317cdfa` |
| `fid` | real FID, float64 little-endian (`DTYPA=2`), first 16384 complex points kept | `b4dacfe47ced48e78198431d54e49965315d5b4ab17ece9fc23431fa68b510e4` |

Originals (not shipped): full `fid` 524288 B
sha256 `955b08017482b7ae41e1b20f99ab83586902cbaf16dadb7242b61257ccbdc925`;
full `acqus` sha256 `30a48b5eda4b1c7f3aee652a4345cb6482ffdff60151ccb15b0a8a21c326100f`.
The FID was truncated to the first 2 s of the 4 s acquisition to keep the repo
budget small; the group-delay transient (first ~78 samples) and every analyte
signal are fully preserved. Local file paths / host IDs were removed from the
`acqus` header comments.

## Acquisition facts (from `acqus`)

- Real AVANCE NEO 400 MHz digital spectrometer, TopSpin 4.0.2, acquired 2018-05-24.
- Sample: 4-vinylbenzoic acid in CDCl3 (teaching-lab dataset; only the two raw
  files are kept — no student/owner identifiable data).
- ¹H at 400.13 MHz, `SW = 20.485 ppm`, `O1 = 2470.802 Hz` (6.175 ppm carrier),
  `TE = 296.13 K`, `PULPROG = zg30`, `DTYPA=2` (float64).
- Digital filter: `GRPDLY = 76`, `DSPFVS = 21` (a real group-delay case).

## Manual annotations (independent reference)

Derived from the TopSpin peak list (`pdata/1/peaklist.xml`, generated by the
spectrometer software, not by this codebase) plus the known structure:

| Assignment | center (ppm) | lines (ppm) | ¹H |
|---|---|---|---|
| ArH ortho-COOH | 8.080 | 8.0921, 8.0716 | 2 |
| ArH ortho-vinyl | 7.500 | 7.5118, 7.4910 | 2 |
| CHCl3 residual | 7.259 | 7.2586 | 1 |
| CH= (dd) | 6.770 | 6.8106, 6.7834, 6.7666, 6.7394 | 1 |
| =CH2 trans | 5.900 | 5.9216, 5.8776 | 1 |
| =CH2 cis | 5.420 | 5.4329, 5.4183, 5.4056, 5.3913 | 1 |

The COOH proton was not observed in the TopSpin peak list; unannotated
residuals (grease near 1.26/2.18 ppm, TMS near 0 ppm) are deliberately left out
of the annotations so they count as spurious in the metrics.

## Known limitation — this layer is NOT_VERIFIED (three-state rule)

Processing this real FID through the current ACP raw-read path
(`nmrglue` → `acp.nmr.spectra.process_bruker_experiment`) does **not** recover
the TopSpin reference positions above: the observed peak set is mirrored about
the carrier (e.g. the 7.5 ppm aromatic doublet appears near 4.8 ppm) and carries
the uncompensated group-delay transient. Reconstructing TopSpin's processed
spectrum from the raw bytes requires a quadrature conjugation for this AVANCE NEO
float64 storage class (real-part correlation 0.70 with conjugation vs 0.015
without), which the pipeline does not apply.

Therefore the benchmark records this fixture as `layer=real`,
`verification.status=not_verified` with explicit reasons while still producing
metrics for diagnosis. The synthetic layer remains the binding acceptance
layer. Do not remove the NOT_VERIFIED marking without first making the pipeline
recover the reference positions.
